title: CHOMPI portable sampler instrument is now open-source (hardware and software)
summary: CHOMPI is a portable sampler instrument that has been made fully open-source, releasing both hardware designs (PCB schematics, enclosure files) and software code, allowing musicians, makers, and developers to build, modify, and customize their own sampling devices.
problem_solved: Democratizes music production hardware by making portable sampler technology freely available for anyone to build or modify.
why_valuable: Enables the maker community and musicians to have full control over their music production tools without proprietary restrictions, fostering innovation in portable audio hardware.
